description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 4th-level spells, Spell Focus (Necromancy)

Benefit: As long as you have a necromancy spell of 4th level or higher in your known spells and have at least 4 MP in your MP pool, you can summon any CR 2 or less undead creature within a range of 30 feet, acting as if summoned by a summon undead spell. Higher-level necromancy spells allow summoning higher-CR undead. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting necromancy spells.

system.requirements: Ability to cast 4th-level spells, Spell Focus (Necromancy)
